base.hostStatus: No willing host/advisor has committed. All roles must be named and consent approved before launch.
base.scientificProtocol: Existing participant kit2.0.1 / shortform2.0. Career Bridge plan review is a separately labeled exploratory output; do not insert it into the frozen A/B task or report a new causal comparison.
gates: 5/5 sources independently double-reviewed with no outstanding semantic hold
Zero unsupported eligibility or employment claims in inspected plans
At least4/5 starters finish the frozen task; report all missing/withdrawn outcomes
Two raters independently assess source correctness, uncertainty, skill connection, feasible action and provenance; retain disagreements
At least4/5 plans receive4/5 actionability items from both raters, without overruling a safety failure
Actual source/support workload no more than120% of funded capacity; stop/rebudget otherwise
No unresolved critical accessibility or privacy failure; accommodations actually usable
At least4/5 consenting respondents indicate willingness to continue; show missing responses separately
base.outputs: Counts and individual consented observations, not employment placements. Stage2 only after all gates and host approval; preserve 112hours/$6240 economic/$500 conditional donated-labor cash model.
